sentences.text: 2.In this case
, the petitioners are the accused in Crime No.22 of 2018 on the file of the first respondent police.

On receipt of the complaint received from the second respondent, the first respondent police registered a case in Crime No.22 of 2018 for the offences under Sections 498A ,
506(i) of IPC and Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
After completion of investigation, final report was filed before the Judicial Magistrate Court cum Additional Mahila Court, Trichy, and the same was taken on file in C.C.No.658 of 2020.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate Court cum Additional Mahila Court, Trichy
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Since the final report is of the year 2020, the petitioners/accused No.1 and 2 have filed the present petition before this Court seeking transfer the case in C.C.No.658 of 2020 pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate Court cum Additional M a h i l a C o u r t , T r i c h y , t o s o m e o t h e r C o u r t i n N a g a p a t t i n a m D i s t r i c t .
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.When
the matter was taken up for hearing on 14.06.2023, this Court did not find any merit in the petition and about to dismiss the same.
At that time, the learned counsel for the petitioners sought for short accommodation for making further submission.

Hence, the case was posted today (20.06.2023) under the caption 'for orders'.
4.Even though, when the matter is taken up for hearing today, there is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.

Hence, the Criminal Original Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution with a direction to the Judicial Magistrate Court cum Additional Mahila Court, Trichy, to complete the trial in C.C.No.658 of 2020 within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
